system.description:
Something looked at your bloodline from very far away and left a mark. You try not to think about what.

  • Bloodline Ability (1st): See perfectly in magical and mundane darkness.
  • Once per day, look at a creature within 60ft to read their surface thoughts (Will save to resist).
  • You have advantage on saves vs psychic damage, fear, and madness effects, and once per day may ask the GM one yes/no question about a creature you can see — the answer comes as a premonition.
  • Bloodline Awakening (15th): Once per day, touch a creature — Fortitude save or AC reduced by 1d4 permanently, 4d10 psychic damage, and they cannot regain HP for 1 hour.
  • Half damage on success.
  • Nonmagical objects touched, up to a 10ft cube, are destroyed regardless of save.
